correctness.rationale: The Dirichlet spacing representation gives iid exponential rankings, with cut edges exactly at strict local gap maxima. The known peak-gap mass integrates to p_j=(j-1)(j+2)2^j/(j+3)! and telescopes to the exact tail q_k=k2^k/(k+2)!. The indicator for a length-at-least-k component uses k+2 independent variables. Neighboring starts within k-1 are exclusive; compatible overlap offsets k and k+1 require two disjoint peak-free blocks, each with probability v_k=2^(k-2)/(k-1)!. Thus the standard dependency-neighborhood bound yields the claimed total variation error. With k^4/n tending to zero and n q_k bounded it vanishes. A second-moment bound plus q_(k+1)/q_k=2(k+1)/(k(k+3)) proves two-point concentration. The actual packaged checker passed 368786 exact/controlled finite assertions; these are not an infinite proof. n>=2k+4 and unique nearest neighbors are explicit.

value.rationale: Largest connected component size directly quantifies worst-case spurious block size in the undirected one-nearest-neighbor circle forest. The result supplies a natural exact critical intensity, total-variation Poisson calibration for rare oversized components, and a sharp two-integer concentration threshold; unlike a fixed-size frequency identity these solve an extreme-size question and rule out an inappropriate continuously centered Gumbel approximation.
